snippets.snippet: Burlington Township Zoning Fees Updated 1/18/2023 ZONING: 2023 Zoning Fee Rates (effective as of 01/18/2023) are as follows: The Board of Trustees reserve the right to increase/decrease zoning fee rates at any time during the year as deemed necessary. Rezoning Application for Hearing Notices $500 payable to Burlington Township Appeal to Board of Zoning Appeals $500 Outdoor Advertising Signs $10 plus additional $0.50 per sq. ft. of sign Residence (1 to 2 family) $0.15 per square foot Oc cupancy Permit (Final Inspection) No Charge Relocation of Structure Permit $20 Garages and Accessory Buildings $0.15 per square foot, $75 minimum Additions to Existing Structure $75 minimum plus $1 per sq. ft in excess 200 sq. ft Commercial and Indus trial Permit $1000 minimum plus $1 per sq. ft in excess of 5000 sq. ft Swimming Pool Permit $20 Trailer - Visitor Permit (Article 5.12) $10 Lot Split $100
